# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 26 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** 1QHa (Cave 1), Col. 26 | **Condition:** very fragmentary

---

**26:1** [...] blessed [...] for You have granted [...] knowledge to Your servant [...]

**26:2** [...] to understand Your wonders and to declare [...] the abundance of [...]

**26:3** [...] Your mercies. Blessed are You, O Lord, God of compassion [...]

**26:4** [...] for the greatness of Your design and the abundance of Your deeds [...]

**26:5** [...] are magnificent. Blessed are You, O Lord, who placed understanding [...]

**26:6** [...] in the heart of Your servant, to gain insight into all these things [...]

**26:7** [...] and to refrain from the works of wickedness, and to bless [...]

**26:8** [...] Your name. For in Your favor [...] all Your works [...]

**26:9** [...] and the son of Your maidservant, You [...] with knowledge [...]

**26:10** [...] to stand in Your presence forever [...]

**26:11** [...] and who is he, a mortal, that he should understand [...]

**26:12** [...] Your great works? And what is one born of woman that he should sit [...]

**26:13** [...] before You? For he is kneaded from dust, and his end [...]

**26:14** [...] is food for worms. He is a thing of spittle, a form of pinched clay [...]

**26:15** [...] and his longing is for the dust. What shall clay answer [...]

**26:16** [...] and that which a hand has formed, what counsel can it grasp? [...]

**26:17** [...] and in what way shall it be found righteous? [...]

**26:18** [...] And as for me, a creature of dust, what [...] shall I say [...]

**26:19** [...] and what shall I devise for myself? For [...] in Your wrath [...]

**26:20** [...] Your wonderful [...] mysteries You have disclosed to the ear of dust [...]

**26:21** [...] and upon the heart of [...] You have inscribed eternal things [...]

**26:22** [...] and You have opened [...] the fountain of understanding [...]

**26:23** [...] for there is no [...] truth except from Your hand [...]

**26:24** [...] and no righteousness apart from Your counsel [...]

**26:25** [...] and all [...] are before You, and through the knowledge of [...]

**26:26** [...] Your truth You have established all things [...]

**26:27** [...] and without Your will nothing is accomplished [...]

**26:28** [...] and nothing is known apart from You [...]

**26:29** [...] Your wonderful mysteries [...] for eternity [...]

**26:30** [...] and ever [...]

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus follows LOGOS for this very fragmentary column. The triple barukh structure is preserved. "Disclosed to the ear of dust" (LOGOS) preferred over PNEUMA's "whispered into the ear of dust" — while evocative, "whispered" adds an interpretive layer not in the Hebrew. "Thing of spittle" (EMET/LOGOS) retained as characteristic Hodayot self-abasement vocabulary. See disagreement log.*
